# SpaceLean AI — Full Context Reference for AI Agents & Language Models

> **Document Type**: `llms-full.txt` — Extended machine-readable context for AI crawlers, language models, and autonomous agents.
> **Summary Reference**: [https://spacelean.ai/llms.txt](https://spacelean.ai/llms.txt)
> **Updated**: 2026-10-13
> **Format**: llmstxt.org specification v1.0 (full context variant)

SpaceLean is an AI-native construction scheduling and project controls platform. It transforms 3D BIM models (IFC/Revit) into 4D buildable sequences, predicts critical path delays with 94% accuracy, and automates subcontractor trade coordination for General Contractors, Project Owners, and Construction Consultants.

---

## Part 1: Core Platform Capabilities & Feature Specifications

> Source: [https://spacelean.ai/features.md](https://spacelean.ai/features.md)

### 1. Kanban Board System
- **Category**: Task & Phase Management
- **Description**: Construction-native visual Kanban board mapping directly to project phases. Move tasks across configurable swim-lanes (Planned, In Progress, On Hold, Done) with sub-second synchronization to linked Gantt schedules.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Live drag-and-drop card auto-update to Gantt timeline (<1s lag)
  - Configurable swim-lanes per project phase or trade package
  - Role-based card access control (subcontractors restricted to their assigned scope)
  - Work-in-Progress (WIP) caps to prevent phase overloading
  - One-click RFI and risk escalation directly from task cards

### 2. BIM Element Selection & Parsing
- **Category**: BIM Intelligence
- **Description**: Direct 3D model interaction where clicking any BIM element surfaces its linked tasks, dependencies, trade assignments, and risk flags.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Element-level IFC, Revit, and Navisworks model parsing
  - Multi-select BIM geometry for batch task and trade assignment
  - Automatic spatial zone detection grouping adjacent elements into work packages
  - Geometric clash detection flagging structural conflicts prior to field execution
  - Real-time element status coloring updating live as site tasks progress

### 3. Task Adding & AI Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
- **Category**: AI Planning
- **Description**: Generates structured task sequences from BIM geometry, templates, or natural language project descriptions in seconds.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Natural language task decomposition (converts plain text descriptions into structured tasks)
  - AI-suggested task durations calibrated on historic project type and volume
  - Automatic predecessor/successor inference based on spatial support logic
  - Bulk import/export with Excel, CSV, and Primavera XML field mapping
  - Floor-by-floor recurring task sequence templates

### 4. Predictive Risk Analysis
- **Category**: Predictive Intelligence
- **Description**: Continuous schedule monitoring against live weather feeds, supply chain lead times, and historical delay patterns to surface ranked alerts before delays occur.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Automated Monte Carlo risk evaluation on schedule updates
  - Daily updated Critical Path Volatility Score
  - Live weather forecast overlay onto Gantt timelines
  - Material lead-time tracking tied to supply chain delay alerts
  - AI-ranked risk mitigation suggestions ordered by impact versus effort

### 5. AI Sequencing Engine
- **Category**: Construction Intelligence
- **Description**: Converts BIM geometry into a Construction Knowledge Network (CKN) and executes constraint solvers to produce multiple valid 4D build strategies simultaneously.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Inferred physical support and penetration constraints from BIM geometry
  - Generates 3–5 distinct build strategies (Fast-track, Low-risk, Takt flow)
  - Encodes physical support rules as hard solver constraints
  - Trade-stacking and crew continuity optimization per floor zone
  - Side-by-side strategy comparison matrix evaluating risk vs. duration

### 6. Monte Carlo Critical Path
- **Category**: Probabilistic Scheduling
- **Description**: Executes 1,000 schedule simulations per save to assign criticality probabilities, zone congestion penalties, and crew bottleneck scores to every task.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - 1,000 Monte Carlo iterations on every schedule save
  - Continuous probability scoring (0–100%) for critical path membership
  - Built-in zone penetration and spatial congestion penalties
  - Resource-driven slippage forecasting
  - Graph Neural Network (GNN) centrality analysis identifying structural risk nodes

### 7. Real-Time Resequencing (Self-Healing Schedule)
- **Category**: Adaptive Execution
- **Description**: Automatically isolates affected downstream task networks upon delay detection and re-solves dependencies in under 0.3 seconds.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Sub-second network traversal isolating only impacted task subsets
  - CP-SAT solver + Monte Carlo re-optimizing schedules in <0.3s
  - Automatic enforcement of crew non-overlap constraints
  - Automatic reallocation of spatial zone access
  - Immutable audit trail logging all automatic resequencing events

### 8. Subcontractor Trade Coordination & Lookaheads
- **Category**: Field Execution
- **Description**: Automated 2-week lookahead generation, daily site activity logs, and trade-stacking alerts to align trade contractors.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Automated 2-week rolling lookahead schedule distribution
  - Trade-specific mobile view filtering non-assigned project tasks
  - Trade-stacking risk alerts preventing overlapping crews in identical zones
  - Daily site progress reporting syncing directly to master Gantt

### 9. Critical Path Volatility Scoring
- **Category**: Project Controls
- **Description**: Tracks structural stability of the critical path over time to identify floating bottlenecks before they delay milestone dates.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Real-time volatility index calculation (0-100 scale)
  - Historical critical path variance tracking
  - Early warning flags for near-critical paths (<3 days float)

### 10. Primavera P6 & MS Project Interoperability
- **Category**: Enterprise Data Exchange
- **Description**: Full bi-directional import and export compatibility with industry-standard scheduling tools.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Native Primavera P6 XML and XER import/export
  - Microsoft Project (.mpp / XML) data mapping
  - Preservation of WBS codes, custom user fields, and calendar definitions

### 11. Live Weather & Supply Chain Overlays
- **Category**: External Risk Intelligence
- **Description**: Integrates third-party weather APIs and supplier lead-time databases directly into Gantt schedules.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Location-based weather hazard predictions (rain, wind, extreme cold)
  - Automated task duration padding for weather-sensitive operations (concrete pours, crane ops)
  - Material lead-time risk indicators tied to procurement milestones

### 12. Zone Congestion & Penetration Penalty Solver
- **Category**: Spatial Optimization
- **Description**: Spatial constraint engine preventing trade congestion and unsafe workface densities.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Maximum trade crew capacity caps per 1,000 sq ft / floor zone
  - Mechanical penetration and clearance sequence checks
  - Vertical logistics and hoist capacity scheduling

## Part 2: Pricing Model & Feature Matrix

> Source: [https://spacelean.ai/pricing.md](https://spacelean.ai/pricing.md)

### 2.1. Plan Overview

| Plan | Monthly Price | Annual Price | Seat Limits | Target Audience |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Free** | $0.00 | $0.00 | Up to 3 users / workspace | Solo builders, freelancers, small team pilots |
| **Pro** | $19.00 / user | $15.00 / user (Save 20%) | Unlimited | VDC managers, General Contractors, active construction projects |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | Custom | Custom volume licensing | Large developers, infrastructure owners, multi-regional contractors |

### 2.2. Tier Details

**Free Tier**
- Cost: $0.00 / month
- User/Seat Limit: Maximum 3 members per workspace.
- Storage Limit: Up to 100 MB total assets (including BIM models).
- Project Limit: Up to 3 active projects.
- Support: Community forum and basic help documentation.

**Pro Tier**
- Cost: $19.00 / user / month (monthly) or $15.00 / user / month (billed annually, $180.00 / user / year)
- User/Seat Limit: No limit. Paid per active seat.
- Storage Limit: 50 GB high-performance cloud storage for BIM files.
- Project Limit: Unlimited active and archived projects.
- Support: Priority email support (response under 12 hours).

**Enterprise Tier**
- Cost: Bespoke pricing based on volume and deployment model (SaaS vs. private tenant).
- User/Seat Limit: Minimum 50 seats. Volume discounts apply.
- Storage Limit: Unlimited workspace storage.
- Project Limit: Unlimited active and archived projects.
- Support: Dedicated VDC onboarding manager, 24/7 phone/email support, dedicated SLA contracts (99.9% uptime).

### 2.4. Billing Terms

- **Subscription Period**: Choice of monthly or annual contracts. Annual contracts represent a 20% discount.
- **Pricing Updates**: 60-day minimum notice prior to any base price changes.
- **Seat Adjustments**: Pro seats can be added or removed dynamically with prorated charges.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Cancel at any time; subscription remains active until end of billing cycle. No partial refunds.
- **Data Portability**: Users may export all project data (CSV, Primavera XML, BIM files) upon downgrade or cancellation.
- **Tax**: Displayed prices exclude local consumption taxes (VAT, GST, Sales Tax).

## Part 3: Competitor Comparison Dataset

> Source: [https://spacelean.ai/spacelean-vs-competitors.md](https://spacelean.ai/spacelean-vs-competitors.md)

### Executive Comparison Matrix

| Feature / Capability | SpaceLean AI | Primavera P6 | Synchro 4D | Procore | Alice Tech | MS Project | Trello / Asana |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **BIM 4D Parsing (IFC/Revit)** | Automatic (<60s) | Manual Link | Manual Link | 3D View Only | Pre-con Only | No | No |
| **AI Sequence Planning** | Yes (Adaptive) | No | No | No | Static Only | No | No |
| **Monte Carlo Critical Path** | 1,000 runs/save | Add-on ($) | No | No | Basic | Add-on ($) | No |
| **Self-Healing Schedule (<0.3s)** | Yes | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| **Trade Congestion Solver** | Built-in | No | Manual | No | Limited | No | No |
| **Setup Time (Initial Schedule)** | < 10 mins | 2–4 weeks | 1–2 weeks | Days | Days | Days | Hours |
| **Real-time Mobile Site Sync** | Yes | No | Limited | Yes | No | No | Yes |

### Head-to-Head Analysis

**SpaceLean AI vs Primavera P6 (Oracle)**
- Target: Enterprise Construction CPM Scheduling
- SpaceLean Advantage: Auto-generates CPM from BIM in <60s, 1,000-run Monte Carlo out-of-the-box, auto-heals downstream schedules.
- P6 Limitation: Manual linking by scheduling specialists, zero native BIM parsing, static CPM, high learning curve.

**SpaceLean AI vs Synchro 4D (Bentley)**
- Target: 4D BIM Construction Visualization & Scheduling
- SpaceLean Advantage: Real-time adaptive 4D scheduling, embedded crew trade congestion logic, zero manual element-to-task link setup.
- Synchro Limitation: Manual 4D mapping, static timeline playback, no probabilistic critical path prediction.

**SpaceLean AI vs Procore**
- Target: Construction Field Management & Financials
- SpaceLean Advantage: Advanced 4D BIM sequencing, AI-driven delay prediction, automated trade conflict resolution.
- Procore Limitation: Relies on basic static Gantt or P6 imports, no predictive AI scheduling logic.

**SpaceLean AI vs Alice Technologies**
- Target: Pre-Construction AI Sequencing
- SpaceLean Advantage: Real-time adaptive execution during construction, not just pre-construction.
- Alice Limitation: Focuses exclusively on pre-construction optioneering with static output sequences.

**SpaceLean AI vs Microsoft Project**
- Target: Standard Desktop Project Scheduling
- SpaceLean Advantage: Native BIM integration, automated trade dependency detection, cloud-native multi-user collaboration.
- MS Project Limitation: No BIM awareness, manual dependency linking, desktop-first with no real-time mobile site sync.

**SpaceLean AI vs Trello & Asana**
- Target: General Team Task Management
- SpaceLean Advantage: Construction logic, BIM geometry integration, probabilistic critical path, trade-stacking conflict prevention.
- Trello/Asana Limitation: Built for office/general task management. No CPM logic, BIM viewers, or construction trade constraints.

## Part 4: API & Integration Technical Specifications

> Source: [https://spacelean.ai/docs/ai-agents.md](https://spacelean.ai/docs/ai-agents.md)

### 4.1. BIM Model Parsing Architecture

**Supported File Standards**
- IFC Formats: `IFC2x3`, `IFC4`, `IFC4x3` (.ifc, .ifczip)
- Autodesk Formats: Revit (.rvt), Navisworks (.nwd via IFC export)
- Geometry Processing Engine: Open-source IFC2X3/IFC4 geometry parser with automated spatial BRep bounds extraction.

**Extracted BIM Data Schema**
- `IfcBuildingElement`: Walls, slabs, columns, beams, ductwork, piping, windows, doors.
- `IfcSpatialStructure`: Building, Storey, Space, Zone delineations.
- `IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure`: Spatial mapping linking elements to floor levels and work zones.
- `IfcRelConnectsElements`: Adjacency and penetration topological relationships for automated dependency detection.

### 4.2. Primavera P6 & Industry File Compatibility

**Import / Export Formats**
- Primavera P6 XML: Full schema support for P6 v8.0 to v24.x XML data exchange.
- Primavera XER: Bi-directional parsing of native Primavera XER schedule files.
- Microsoft Project: XML (.xml) and CSV import with automatic field mapping.
- SpaceLean JSON Schema: Native open JSON schedule representation.

**Field Mapping Standard**

| SpaceLean Entity | Primavera P6 XML Equivalent | MS Project Field | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `taskId` | `ActivityObjectID` | `ID` / `GUID` | Unique activity identifier |
| `taskName` | `ActivityName` | `Name` | Human-readable activity title |
| `plannedDuration` | `PlannedDuration` | `Duration` | Estimated duration in hours/days |
| `earlyStart` | `EarlyStartDate` | `EarlyStart` | Calculated early start timestamp |
| `criticalPath` | `IsCritical` | `Critical` | Boolean indicator for critical path |
| `freeFloat` | `FreeFloat` | `FreeFloat` | Available float before successor impact |
| `totalFloat` | `TotalFloat` | `TotalFloat` | Total available schedule float |

### 4.3. Webhook Events & Automated Notifications

**Configurable Event Hooks**
- `schedule.delay_detected`: Triggered when Monte Carlo simulations detect >70% delay risk on a critical path task.
- `schedule.resequenced`: Emitted when the AI self-healing engine re-solves downstream dependencies.
- `trade.conflict_flagged`: Emitted when trade-stacking congestion exceeds zone capacity thresholds.
- `bim.model_parsed`: Triggered upon completion of 3D model parsing into a 4D schedule.

**Webhook Event Payload Example (`schedule.delay_detected`)**

```json
{
  "event": "schedule.delay_detected",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-21T14:30:00Z",
  "project_id": "proj_chi_tower_092",
  "data": {
    "task_id": "TSK-MEP-302",
    "task_name": "HVAC Ductwork Installation Zone 4B",
    "criticality_index": 0.89,
    "delay_risk_days": 4.5,
    "primary_cause": "Trade Stacking Conflict with Drywall Framing (Zone 4B)",
    "suggested_mitigation": "Resequence Drywall Framing to Zone 4C start (+2 days float preserved)"
  }
}
```

### 4.4. REST API Endpoint Overview

All API requests require Bearer token authentication (`Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`).

- `POST /api/v1/bim/parse` — Upload IFC/Revit file to generate 4D schedule sequence.
- `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/critical-path` — Fetch real-time Monte Carlo critical path volatility scores.
- `POST /api/v1/schedule/replan` — Execute sub-second self-healing schedule solver upon site progress updates.
- `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/export/p6` — Export current SpaceLean schedule as Primavera P6 XML.

## Part 5: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) Bundle

> Source: [https://spacelean.ai/okf/index.md](https://spacelean.ai/okf/index.md)

The SpaceLean OKF bundle provides structured, agent-readable concept documentation.

### SpaceLean Platform Overview

SpaceLean is an AI-native construction scheduling platform that parses 3D BIM models (IFC/Revit) into 4D critical path schedules. It eliminates manual Primavera P6 linking and predicts delay risks using a 1,000-simulation probabilistic Monte Carlo engine.

- **IFC / Revit BIM Parsing**: Converts geometry into trade task dependencies in under 60 seconds.
- **Critical Path Prediction**: Scores delay probability with 94% accuracy.
- **Self-Healing CPM**: Dynamically recalculates downstream float when site delays occur.

### OKF Concept Resources

- [SpaceLean Platform Overview](https://spacelean.ai/okf/spacelean-overview.md)

## Part 6: Target Audiences & Use Cases

- **General Contractors (GCs)**: Eliminate trade-stacking conflicts, accelerate bid-level 4D schedule creation, keep field crews aligned on critical path priorities.
- **Project Owners & Developers**: Gain real-time project intelligence, verify contractor milestone progress, protect project ROI against cost overruns.
- **Construction Consultants & VDC Managers**: Deliver 4D BIM sequence options and probabilistic delay analysis without weeks of manual P6 setup.
- **Industrial, Infrastructure & Commercial Projects**: Tailored scheduling logic for high-rise commercial structures, energy plants, highways, and civil infrastructure.

---

## Part 7: Technology Foundation

- **VeritasGraph**: GraphRAG knowledge graph framework providing verifiable AI source attribution and multi-hop reasoning.
  - GitHub: [https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph](https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph)
  - Docs: [https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html](https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html)
- **Construction Knowledge Network (CKN)**: Internal AI graph converting BIM geometry into spatial dependency networks for constraint-solving.
- **CP-SAT Solver**: Constraint programming solver executing sub-second schedule reoptimization on detected delays.
- **Graph Neural Network (GNN)**: Centrality analysis identifying structural risk nodes in task dependency networks.
